items.stem: Where should the human-approval step sit in a customer follow-up automation?

options.text: Before any message is sent to the customer
options.rationale: Correct: approval must gate the outbound action, not follow it.

options.text: After the message has already been sent
options.rationale: Approval after sending cannot prevent a bad message.
Errors are not the only risk; wrong-but-successful sends also need gating.

options.text: It is unnecessary if ChatGPT drafted the message
options.rationale: AI drafting is exactly why human approval is needed.

items.explanation: Correct: approval must gate the outbound action, not follow it.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: Which TWO controls must a customer-messaging automation include? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Honouring opt-outs before drafting or sending
options.rationale: Correct: contacting opted-out customers is a compliance breach.

options.text: A kill-switch to halt the automation safely
options.rationale: Correct: an operator must be able to stop a misbehaving automation.

options.text: Sending as fast as the API allows
options.rationale: Ignoring rate limits and pacing invites blocks and complaints.

options.text: Removing the record of sent messages to save space
options.rationale: Destroying send records removes the audit trail.

items.explanation: Correct: contacting opted-out customers is a compliance breach.
items.provenance: original Mastemy item drafted by an AI agent; no external question source

items.stem: A step in the n8n flow fails partway through composing a follow-up. What should the flow do?

options.text: Stop and surface the failure without sending a broken message
options.rationale: Correct: a failed step must not result in an incorrect customer send.

options.text: Send whatever was composed so far
options.rationale: Sending a partial message harms the customer relationship.
Unbounded retries can spam the customer or hang the flow.

options.text: Skip the failed step and continue
options.rationale: Silently skipping a step can send an incomplete or wrong message.

items.explanation: Correct: a failed step must not result in an incorrect customer send.
